Name: Exploitation Usability Optical Information
Description: The Exploitation Usability Optical Information extension is optional. EXOPT provides metadata that allows a user program to determine if the image is suitable for the exploitation problem currently being performed. It contains some of the fields, which would make up a NGA standard directory entry. The format and descriptions for the user-defined fields of the EXOPTA are detailed in table E-10. A single EXOPT is placed in the image subheader with the corresponding AIMID and ACFT extensions.

ANGLE_TO_NORTH.Name: Angle to True North
ANGLE_TO_NORTH.Description: This field indicateds the angle, measured clockwise, from the first-row vector (pointing from the first column to the last) to a vector pointing to True North.

MEAN_GSD.Name: Mean Ground Sample Distance
MEAN_GSD.Description: This field indicates the geometric mean of the cross and along scan center-to-center distance between contiguous ground samples. Accuracy = plus or minus 10% Note: Systems requiring an extended range shall insert a default value of 000.0 for this field and utilize the PIAMC tag.

DYNAMIC_RANGE.Name: Dynamic Range of Image Pixels
DYNAMIC_RANGE.Description: This field indicates the dynamic range of image pixels.

OBL_ANG.Name: Obliquity Angle
OBL_ANG.Description: This field indicates the angle between the local NED horizontal and the optical axis of the image.

ROLL_ANG.Name: Roll Angle
ROLL_ANG.Description: This field indicates the Roll Angle of the platform body.

PRIME_ID.Name: Primary Target ID
PRIME_ID.Description: This field indicates the primary target ID.

PRIME_BE.Name: Primary Target BE or OSUFFIX
PRIME_BE.Description: This field indicates the Primary Target BE or OSUFFIX (target designator).

N_SEC.Name: Number Of Secondary Targets in Image
N_SEC.Description: This field Determines the number of SECTG extensions present in the image subheader.

N_SEG.Name: Number Of Segments
N_SEG.Description: This field indicates the number of separate imagery pieces within an imagery operation.
